title: Government knowledge that scalar waves alter radioisotope decay rates

tellings.quote: technology and the government's known for years that um you can actually affect the decay rate of radioisotopes by certain uh scalar electromagnetic waves.

plain: A scientist named Steve, who studies objects he says are alien implants in human bodies, cites the books of a writer, Tom Bearden. He says the government has known for years that certain scalar electromagnetic waves, an unusual kind of wave Bearden wrote about, can change how fast radioactive materials decay. If true, it would mean a secret way to control radioactivity.
